title: Timezone
description:
Detailed timezone information for the requested location or identifier.

Contains timezone metadata such as UTC offset, daylight saving time (DST)
status, formatted timestamps, and DST transition information.

name.description: IANA timezone identifier for the location.

offset.description: Standard timezone offset from UTC in hours.

offset_with_dst.description: Timezone offset from UTC including daylight saving time.

date_time.description: Current date and time in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` format.

date_time_wti.description: Date and time with timezone information.

date_time_ymd.description: ISO-8601 formatted date and time with timezone offset.

current_time_unix.description: Unix timestamp representing the current date and time.

week.description: Week number of the current year.

current_tz_abbreviation.description: Abbreviation of the timezone currently in effect.

current_tz_full_name.description: Full name of the timezone currently in effect.

standard_tz_full_name.description: Full name of the standard timezone.

is_dst.description: Indicates whether daylight saving time is currently active.

dst_savings.description: Number of hours added during daylight saving time.

dst_exists.description: Indicates whether the region observes daylight saving time.

dst_tz_abbreviation.description: Abbreviation used during daylight saving time.

dst_tz_full_name.description: Full name used during daylight saving time.

dst_start.description:
Represents a daylight saving time transition event including the
moment when DST begins or ends.

utc_time.description: UTC timestamp when the DST transition occurs.

duration.description: Time change applied during the transition.

gap.description: Indicates whether an hour is skipped during the transition.

date_time_after.description: Local date and time immediately after the DST change.

date_time_before.description: Local date and time immediately before the DST change.

overlap.description: Indicates whether clock time overlaps during the transition.

dst_end.description:
Represents a daylight saving time transition event including the
moment when DST begins or ends.

utc_time.description: UTC timestamp when the DST transition occurs.

duration.description: Time change applied during the transition.

gap.description: Indicates whether an hour is skipped during the transition.

date_time_after.description: Local date and time immediately after the DST change.

date_time_before.description: Local date and time immediately before the DST change.

overlap.description: Indicates whether clock time overlaps during the transition.
